title.en: Markets and who gains: the turbine quota (Q1)
title.zh: 市场与得失：风机进口配额（第 1 题）

description.en: Demand and supply as values and costs, surplus as areas, externalities, and why a quota on imports costs USF 2000.
description.zh: 把需求和供给读成价值和成本，用面积算剩余，外部性，以及进口配额为什么让 USF 亏 2000。

description.en: With a quota, reading the price off the supply curve instead of the demand curve
description.zh: 有配额时，用供给曲线而不是需求曲线来定价格

description.en: Counting the quota rent as the importing country's gain
description.zh: 把配额租金算成进口国自己的收益

rows.en: only 60 can come in; buyers bid the price up the demand curve
rows.zh: 只能进 60 台，买家沿需求曲线把价格抬上去

rows.en: consumers lose 1600, the cleaner air loses 400; the higher price goes to foreign sellers
rows.zh: 消费者少 1600，清洁空气少 400；涨价的钱流向外国卖家

items.en: A demand curve is a list of values, a supply curve a list of costs.
items.zh: 需求曲线是一串价值，供给曲线是一串成本。

items.en: Surplus is an area: value minus price for buyers, price minus cost for sellers.
items.zh: 剩余是面积：买方是价值减价格，卖方是价格减成本。

items.en: An externality is value (or harm) to people outside the sale.
items.zh: 外部性是买卖双方以外的人得到的价值（或损害）。

items.en: A quota fixes the quantity; demand then sets the price, and the gap between the two prices is the quota rent.
items.zh: 配额卡住数量；价格于是由需求定，两个价格之间的差就是配额租金。

items.en: "Social benefit" counts only the people of the country asked about.
items.zh: “社会收益”只算题目问的那个国家的人。

title.en: Demand is value, supply is cost
title.zh: 需求是价值，供给是成本

text.en: Read the demand curve backwards: solve $Q = 120 - 2p$ for $p$ and you get $p = 60 - Q/2$, what a buyer will pay for the $Q$-th turbine. The first one is worth up to \$60 to someone; the 100th is worth only \$10. A downward slope just says: the more there already are, the less one more is worth.
text.zh: 把需求曲线倒过来读：从 $Q = 120 - 2p$ 解出 $p = 60 - Q/2$，这是第 $Q$ 台风机买方最多愿付的价钱。第 1 台有人愿意出 60 美元；第 100 台只值 10 美元。向下倾斜说的就是：已经有的越多，再多一台就越不值钱。

text.en: The supply curve $Q = 10p$, read backwards ($p = Q/10$), is what it costs Middle Kingdom's sellers to send one more turbine: their marginal cost. At any price they ship every unit that costs them less than the price.
text.zh: 供给曲线 $Q = 10p$ 倒过来（$p = Q/10$），是中央王国（MK）的卖家多送一台的成本，也就是他们的边际成本。在任何价格下，凡是成本低于价格的台数，他们都会送。

text.en: Where the two curves cross, the last turbine sold is worth exactly what it costs: that is the competitive equilibrium. Two words the exam likes:
text.zh: 两条曲线相交处，卖出的最后一台的价值正好等于它的成本：这就是竞争均衡。考试爱用的两个词：

items.en: **A movement along a curve** happens when the price changes: buyers buy less at a higher price.
items.zh: **沿着曲线移动**（movement along）是价格变了：价格高了，买方就少买。

items.en: **A shift of a curve** happens when anything else changes: income, tastes, the price of a substitute (demand); technology, input prices, the number of sellers (supply). A tax or a subsidy can be drawn as a shift.
items.zh: **曲线移动**（shift）是别的东西变了：收入、偏好、替代品的价格（需求）；技术、投入品价格、卖家数量（供给）。税和补贴也可以画成曲线的移动。

items.en: **Consumer surplus** (CS) = what buyers would have paid minus what they paid: the area under demand and above the price. For a straight demand line it is a triangle, $\tfrac12 \times Q \times (\text{intercept} - p)$.
items.zh: **消费者剩余**（consumer surplus, CS）= 买方愿付的 − 实付的：需求曲线之下、价格之上的面积。需求是直线时就是个三角形，$\tfrac12 \times Q \times (\text{截距} - p)$。

items.en: **Producer surplus** (PS) = what sellers get minus their costs: the area above supply and below the price.
items.zh: **生产者剩余**（producer surplus, PS）= 卖方收入 − 成本：供给曲线之上、价格之下的面积。

items.en: **Total surplus** = CS + PS (+ tax revenue, + externalities): the area between demand and supply up to the quantity traded. With no externality, the free market maximises it: every unit worth more than it costs is traded, and no other.
items.zh: **总剩余** = CS + PS（+ 税收，+ 外部性）：成交量以内、需求与供给之间的面积。没有外部性时，自由市场让它最大：价值高于成本的每一单位都成交，其余的都不成交。

items.en: **Deadweight loss** (DWL) = total surplus lost when the quantity is pushed away from that point, by a tax, a quota or a monopolist. It is always a triangle pointing at the efficient quantity.
items.zh: **无谓损失**（deadweight loss, DWL）= 数量被税、配额或垄断推离那个点时，总剩余少掉的部分。它总是一个指向有效数量的三角形。

title.en: The question that decides Q1c: whose surplus counts?
title.zh: 决定 1c 的关键：谁的剩余算数？

body.en: "USF Social Benefit" counts only people in USF: its consumers, its government and the cleaner air. USF has no turbine makers, and Middle Kingdom's sellers are foreign, so their producer surplus is **not** counted. Every extra dollar USF pays them is a loss to USF.
body.zh: “USF 社会收益”只算 USF 境内的人：消费者、政府、清洁空气。USF 自己不造风机，中央王国的卖家是外国人，他们的生产者剩余**不算**。USF 多付给他们的每一块钱，都是 USF 的损失。

title.zh: 外部性：买卖之外的价值

text.en: Each turbine gives USF citizens \$10 of cleaner air, but the buyer does not count it when deciding. So the value of one more turbine to USF is the demand curve **plus 10**: $p = 70 - Q/2$, the dashed green line in the next figure.
text.zh: 每台风机给 USF 居民带来 10 美元的清洁空气，可买家做决定时不算这一份。所以多一台风机对 USF 的价值是需求曲线**再加 10**：$p = 70 - Q/2$，也就是下一张图里的绿色虚线。

items.en: **Positive externality** (cleaner air, vaccination, education): the market buys too little. The classic fix is a **Pigouvian subsidy** equal to the external benefit per unit.
items.zh: **正外部性**（清洁空气、疫苗、教育）：市场买得太少。经典的办法是**庇古补贴**（Pigouvian subsidy），每单位补贴等于外部收益。

items.en: **Negative externality** (pollution, congestion): the market buys too much. The fix is a **Pigouvian tax** equal to the external harm per unit.
items.zh: **负外部性**（污染、拥堵）：市场买得太多。办法是**庇古税**（Pigouvian tax），每单位税等于外部损害。

items.en: In welfare sums, add (or subtract) the externality per unit times the quantity: here $+10 \times Q$.
items.zh: 算福利时，加上（或减去）每单位外部性 × 数量：这里是 $+10 \times Q$。

text.en: If the sellers were USF's own firms, the best quantity would be where value to USF meets cost, $70 - Q/2 = Q/10$, so $Q \approx 117$: more than the free market's 100. But here the sellers are foreign, and that changes the sum (see "the wider topic").
text.zh: 如果卖家是 USF 自己的厂商，最优数量在对 USF 的价值等于成本处：$70 - Q/2 = Q/10$，$Q \approx 117$，比自由市场的 100 多。可这里卖家是外国人，账就不一样了（见“这类题的全貌”）。

title.en: The quota, as areas you can move
title.zh: 配额：一组可以拖动的面积

caption.en: Drag the quota. Gold $A$: what USF buyers pay above the free-trade price on the turbines they still buy. Purple $B$: the value lost on the turbines no longer bought. Green: their lost cleaner air. Right: USF social benefit against the quota; switch to selling the licences to keep the rent at home.
caption.zh: 拖动配额。金色 $A$：USF 买家在仍然买的那些风机上多付的钱（比自由贸易价格高出的部分）。紫色 $B$：不再买的那些风机丢掉的价值。绿色：它们带走的清洁空气。右边：USF 社会收益随配额的变化；切换成“拍卖许可证”，租金就留在国内。

text.en: The quota fixes the **quantity** at 60. The sellers would happily ship more at 30, but they may not; so the price is whatever makes buyers want exactly 60, read off the **demand** curve.
text.zh: 配额卡住的是**数量**：60 台。价格 30 时卖家很想多送，可是不许；所以价格就是让买家恰好只想要 60 台的那个价，从**需求**曲线上读。

prompt.en: Under the quota of 60, which curve gives the price buyers pay?
prompt.zh: 配额 60 台时，买家付的价格从哪条曲线读？

feedback.en: That is the lowest price at which MK would send 60, not what buyers pay. At 6, buyers would want 108 turbines but only 60 exist, so they bid the price up.
feedback.zh: 这是 MK 愿意送 60 台的最低价，不是买家付的价。价格 6 时买家想要 108 台，可只有 60 台，他们会把价格抬上去。

label.en: Neither: the price stays at the free-trade 10
label.zh: 都不是：价格还是自由贸易时的 10

feedback.en: At 10 buyers want 100 turbines, but only 60 may come in: the shortage pushes the price up.
feedback.zh: 价格 10 时买家想要 100 台，可只许进 60 台：短缺会把价格推高。

explain.en: With the quantity fixed, buyers compete for the 60 turbines until only 60 are wanted: $p = 30$. The gap between 30 and the sellers' price 6 is the **quota rent**, $(30 - 6) \times 60 = 1440$, and it goes to whoever holds the import licences.
explain.zh: 数量被卡死后，买家争抢这 60 台，直到只有 60 台被需要：$p = 30$。30 与卖家价格 6 之间的差是**配额租金**（quota rent），$(30 - 6) \times 60 = 1440$，归持有进口许可证的人。

why.en: Buyers want as many as sellers ship.
why.zh: 买方想买的 = 卖方愿卖的。
任一条曲线都给出数量（需求：$120 - 20 = 100$）。

prompt.en: With $p = 10$, how many turbines are traded?

why.en: At most 60 can be imported, and at the old price buyers want 100, so the quota binds.
why.zh: 最多进口 60 台，而原价下买方想要 100 台，所以配额是紧的。

why.en: With the quantity fixed, the **demand** curve sets the price: 30 is the price at which buyers want exactly 60.
why.zh: 数量被卡死后，由**需求**曲线定价：价格到 30 时，买方恰好只想要 60 台。

why.en: Check: at 30, MK would like to ship 300, so the quota really is what limits the market.
why.zh: 检验：价格 30 时 MK 想送 300 台，确实是配额在卡数量。

title.en: Q1c: USF social benefit, before and after
title.zh: 1c：配额前后的 USF 社会收益

why.en: Subscript 0: free trade. The triangle under demand ($p = 60 - Q/2$) and above $p = 10$.
why.zh: 下标 0：自由贸易。需求线（$p = 60 - Q/2$）之下、$p = 10$ 之上的三角形。

why.en: Add the cleaner air: \$10 for each of the 100 turbines. No USF producers, no tax revenue.
why.zh: 加上清洁空气：100 台每台 10 美元。USF 没有生产者，也没有税收。

why.en: Subscript 1: with the quota. The smaller triangle above the new price 30.
why.zh: 下标 1：有配额。新价格 30 之上的小三角形。

why.en: Only 60 turbines clean the air now. The quota rent goes to MK sellers, not to USF.
why.zh: 现在只有 60 台在清洁空气。配额租金归 MK 卖家，不归 USF。

why.en: USF is **2000 worse off** with the quota.

prompt.en: Consumer surplus with the quota: the triangle above $p = 30$, up to $Q = 60$.
prompt.zh: 有配额时的消费者剩余：$p = 30$ 之上、到 $Q = 60$ 为止的三角形。

rows.en: USF buyers pay \$20 more on each of the 60 turbines they still buy; it goes to MK sellers
rows.zh: USF 买家仍买的 60 台每台多付 20 美元，流向 MK 卖家

rows.en: the value of the 40 turbines no longer bought, above their free-trade price
rows.zh: 不再买的那 40 台，高出自由贸易价格的那部分价值

rows.en: the 40 missing turbines no longer clean the air
rows.zh: 少掉的 40 台不再清洁空气
消费者剩余少 1600（$A + B$），外部收益少 400

text.en: Writing the answer this way, piece by piece, earns the method marks even if one number slips, and shows the examiner you know *why* USF loses.
text.zh: 按块写答案，就算某个数算错，思路分也拿得到，还能让阅卷人看到你知道 USF *为什么*亏。

prompt.en: Compared with free trade, who is better off with the quota?
prompt.zh: 和自由贸易相比，配额让谁过得更好？

feedback.en: They pay 30 instead of 10 and buy 40 fewer turbines: they lose 1600.
feedback.zh: 他们付 30 而不是 10，还少买了 40 台：少了 1600。

feedback.en: Only if it sold the import licences. As set, the quota raises no revenue.
feedback.zh: 只有在出售进口许可证时才会。按题目设定，配额不带来任何收入。

label.en: Nobody: the quota only moves money around
label.zh: 没人：配额只是把钱挪了个地方

feedback.en: Some of it is moved (to MK), but $B$ and 400 of cleaner air are simply lost.
feedback.zh: 有一部分是挪了（挪给 MK），但 $B$ 和 400 的清洁空气是真没了。

explain.en: MK sellers now get \$30 for turbines they would sell for \$6 or less. Their gain is the whole rent, 1440: the rectangle $A$ plus the strip from 6 to 10 that they used to give away at the free-trade price.
explain.zh: MK 卖家对那些 6 美元以下就愿意卖的风机收到 30 美元。他们得到全部租金 1440：矩形 $A$，加上 6 到 10 之间那一条（自由贸易时他们按 10 卖，现在多拿了）。

title.en: A tariff instead, and who keeps the rent

text.en: A quota and a tariff can cut imports to the same 60. The difference is who keeps the gap between the buyers' price and the sellers' price.
text.zh: 配额和关税都能把进口压到 60 台。区别在于：买方价格和卖方价格之间的那道差，归谁。

text.en: A tariff of $t$: buyers pay $p_s + t$ when sellers get $p_s$, so solve $120 - 2(p_s + t) = 10p_s$. With $t = 24$: $p_s = 6$, buyers pay 30, imports 60, and the revenue $24 \times 60 = 1440$ stays in USF. A quota whose rent goes abroad is like a tariff whose revenue is handed to the foreign sellers.
text.zh: 每台征 $t$ 的关税：卖方得 $p_s$ 时买方付 $p_s + t$，解 $120 - 2(p_s + t) = 10p_s$。$t = 24$ 时：$p_s = 6$，买方付 30，进口 60，税收 $24 \times 60 = 1440$ 留在 USF。租金流到国外的配额，就像把关税收入交给了外国卖家。

text.en: Beyond the exam: here even a tariff cannot help USF
text.zh: 超出考试：这里连关税也帮不了 USF

text.en: Two forces pull in opposite directions. The cleaner air says *import more*. But USF is the only buyer of MK's turbines, and buying one more raises the price on every unit (supply slopes up), which says *import less*. USF's welfare, counting what it pays MK at the supply price $Q/10$:
text.zh: 两股力量方向相反。清洁空气说*多进口*。可 USF 是 MK 风机的唯一买家，多买一台会抬高每一台的价格（供给向上倾斜），这又说*少进口*。把按供给价 $Q/10$ 付给 MK 的钱算进去，USF 的福利是：

text.en: It peaks at exactly $Q = 100$, the free-trade quantity: the two forces cancel, so no quota or tariff can help USF (the gold curve in the figure above peaks at 100). With no externality, the peak would be at $Q \approx 86$, and a small tariff would raise USF's welfare at MK's expense: the "optimal tariff" of a large buyer.
text.zh: 它恰好在 $Q = 100$，也就是自由贸易数量处最大：两股力量抵消了，任何配额或关税都帮不了 USF（上面那张图里金色曲线的最高点就在 100）。如果没有外部性，最高点在 $Q \approx 86$，一点小关税就能以 MK 为代价提高 USF 的福利：这就是大买家的“最优关税”。

title.en: Traps, and how the question could change
title.zh: 易错点，以及题目可能怎么变

items.en: Reading the quota price off the **supply** curve. Under a quota the buyers set the price: use **demand**.
items.zh: 用**供给**曲线读配额价格。配额下由买方定价：用**需求**曲线。

items.en: Counting the rectangle $A$ as a transfer *inside* USF. Here it goes abroad, so it is a loss for USF.
items.zh: 把矩形 $A$ 当成 USF *内部*的转移。这里它流到了国外，所以是 USF 的损失。

items.en: Forgetting the externality on the turbines that are no longer bought (the second 400).
items.zh: 忘了不再买的那些风机也带走了外部收益（第二个 400）。

rows.en: Buyers pay $p_s + t$; solve demand at $p_s + t$ = supply at $p_s$. Add the revenue $t \times Q$ to USF.
rows.zh: 买方付 $p_s + t$；令需求（按 $p_s + t$）= 供给（按 $p_s$）。把税收 $t \times Q$ 加到 USF。

rows.en: Add the rent $(p_b - p_s) \times Q$ to USF.
rows.zh: 把租金 $(p_b - p_s) \times Q$ 加到 USF。

rows.en: Subtract the harm per unit times $Q$; now restricting imports can *raise* welfare.
rows.zh: 减去每单位危害 × $Q$；这时限制进口反而可能*提高*福利。

rows.en: USF also has its own producers
Their producer surplus counts: a quota then moves surplus from USF buyers to USF producers.
rows.zh: 他们的生产者剩余要算：配额就把剩余从本国买方转给本国生产者。

title.en: Your turn: a quota with new numbers

prompt.en: Demand is $Q = 200 - 4p$, imports are supplied by $Q = 6p$, a quota allows 60 units, and each unit gives USF \$5 of external benefit. By how much does USF social benefit change with the quota? (Negative if USF is worse off.)
prompt.zh: 需求 $Q = 200 - 4p$，进口供给 $Q = 6p$，配额 60 台，每台给 USF 带来 5 美元外部收益。配额让 USF 社会收益变化多少？（变差就填负数。）

explain.en: Free trade: $200 - 4p = 6p$ gives $p = 20$, $Q = 120$; inverse demand $p = 50 - Q/4$; $SB = \tfrac12 \times 120 \times 30 + 5 \times 120 = 2400$. Quota: $p = (200 - 60)/4 = 35$; $SB = \tfrac12 \times 60 \times 15 + 5 \times 60 = 750$. Change $= -1650$: rectangle $15 \times 60 = 900$, triangle $\tfrac12 \times 15 \times 60 = 450$, air $5 \times 60 = 300$.

hints.en: Price under the quota: put $Q = 60$ into the demand curve.
hints.zh: 配额下的价格：把 $Q = 60$ 代进需求曲线。

hints.en: Social benefit = consumer surplus + \$5 per unit. The foreign sellers do not count.
hints.zh: 社会收益 = 消费者剩余 + 每台 5 美元。外国卖家不算。

prompt.en: Back to Q1 (demand $Q = 120 - 2p$, supply $Q = 10p$). USF puts a tariff of \$6 on each imported turbine. How many turbines are imported?
prompt.zh: 回到第 1 题（需求 $Q = 120 - 2p$，供给 $Q = 10p$）。USF 对每台进口风机征 6 美元关税。进口多少台？

explain.en: Buyers pay $p_s + 6$: $120 - 2(p_s + 6) = 10p_s$, so $108 = 12p_s$, $p_s = 9$ and $Q = 90$. Buyers pay 15.

hints.en: The sellers get $p_s$, the buyers pay $p_s + 6$: put each price in its own curve.
hints.zh: 卖方得 $p_s$，买方付 $p_s + 6$：每个价格代进各自的曲线。

title.en: Your turn: USF with the tariff

prompt.en: With that \$6 tariff (90 imported, buyers pay 15), what is USF social benefit? Count consumer surplus, the cleaner air (\$10 per turbine) and the tariff revenue.
prompt.zh: 征 6 美元关税（进口 90 台，买方付 15）时，USF 社会收益是多少？算上消费者剩余、清洁空气（每台 10 美元）和关税收入。

explain.en: $CS = \tfrac12 \times 90 \times (60 - 15) = 2025$, air $= 900$, revenue $= 6 \times 90 = 540$; total 3465, only 35 below free trade. Most of what buyers pay extra comes back as revenue.
explain.zh: $CS = \tfrac12 \times 90 \times (60 - 15) = 2025$，空气 $= 900$，税收 $= 6 \times 90 = 540$；合计 3465，只比自由贸易少 35。买家多付的大部分又作为税收回来了。
